$comment: Advisories accepted with justification for the CI dependency gate (SEC-046). Each entry MUST have a reason and an owner-reviewed expiry. Anything NOT listed here, at high/critical severity, fails the build. Review on or before each expiry.
$resolved: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (brace-expansion) was allowlisted here on the premise that the only npm-offered fix was a breaking-major eslint-plugin-import upgrade. That stopped being true once 1.1.18, 2.1.4 and 5.0.9 shipped: all three are patch releases inside the majors already installed, so every consumer range admits them and `npm update brace-expansion` fixes all nine install paths with no override and no package.json change. Exception removed 2026-08-06 rather than left to expire. | GHSA-q7rr-3cgh-j5r3 (Prometheus exporter HTTP-server crash) and GHSA-45rx-2jwx-cxfr (JaegerPropagator DoS) were allowlisted pending a breaking-major OTel upgrade (SEC-056). CLN-5 (2026-09-12) upgraded @opentelemetry/api to ^1.9.1, sdk-node and exporter-prometheus to 0.222.0, and auto-instrumentations-node to 0.80.0 — one mutually compatible patched set (`npm ls @opentelemetry/api` shows a single version). `npm audit --omit=dev --json` no longer reports either GHSA at any severity, so both exceptions are removed rather than left to expire on 2026-10-11.
